# SEC filing ingestion — Roadmap

## Outcomes

Source: your partner's words, 2026-11-06. Background: specs/sec-filing-index-ingestion-spec.md, specs/sec-filing-index-ingestion-adr.md (both Proposed; the spec covers O1 only and its §2.2 puts O2–O3 out of its own scope).
Choices made: Python 3.14 (`.python-version`). uv workspace with the four existing packages under `packages/`. Hosting platform not yet chosen: the ADR is Proposed, and Stage 8 settles it.

| # | Outcome | Track | Rank | Cost (estimate; basis) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| O1 | The quarterly and daily index files, ingested into one filing-index table | A | 1 | Small: about 130 quarterly files since 1993 plus one daily file per business day, minutes of downloading at 3 req/s (SEC full-index and daily-index directories); measured by Stage 1 |
| O2 | The individual submissions that the index rows name, downloaded | A | 2 | Large: millions of files, weeks at 3 req/s (index row count × request rate; not yet measured); measured by Stage 3 |
| O3 | 10-K and 8-K filings handled: picked out of the submissions, with their main documents extracted | A | 3 | Unknown until submissions are on disk; measured by Stage 4 |

Tracks: A — SEC filing ingestion (known progression).

## Stages

- [ ] Stage 1: Index table core
      Objective: Build a filing-index table from real SEC quarterly and daily index files over a bounded range.
      Outcomes: O1
      Consumes: nothing (package scaffolds only)
      Produces: A filing-index table and the code that fetches and parses quarterly and daily master indexes; specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-1-findings.md
      Exit: A table built from at least one real archived quarter and one real daily index, its row count checked against the source files; findings record files fetched, bytes, rows, elapsed time and request rate of the real run
      Leaves out: full index history and daily catch-up (Stage 2); fixture suite for historical index formats (Stage 2); durable state and replay (Stage 5); quarterly reconciliation (Stage 7); scheduling and deployment (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 2: Full index history and daily catch-up
      Objective: Extend the index table to every quarter since 1993 and every daily index to date.
      Outcomes: O1
      Consumes: Stage 1's table and index fetch/parse code; Stage 1 findings (measured per-file cost)
      Produces: The complete filing-index table, catchable up to the present on demand; fixture suite for historical index formats
      Exit: Every quarter from 1993 to the open quarter and every available daily index is in the table, or listed as an unresolved gap; fixtures cover each historical index format met in that range
      Leaves out: durable state and replay (Stage 5); quarterly reconciliation (Stage 7); scheduling and deployment (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 3: Submissions sample
      Objective: Download the submissions that a bounded slice of the index table names, and measure what full history would cost.
      Outcomes: O2
      Consumes: Stage 2's complete filing-index table
      Produces: Downloaded submissions for the slice and the code that fetches them; specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-3-findings.md
      Exit: Every submission named by the chosen slice is on disk or listed as failed; findings record files, bytes, elapsed time, request rate, and the full-history projection derived from them
      Leaves out: durable state and replay (Stage 5); full-history submissions (Stage 6); scheduling and deployment (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 4: 10-K and 8-K handling on the sample
      Objective: Pick 10-K and 8-K filings out of the sampled submissions and extract their main documents.
      Outcomes: O3
      Consumes: Stage 3's downloaded submissions
      Produces: Extracted main documents for the sample's 10-K and 8-K filings and the code that extracts them; specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-4-findings.md
      Exit: Each 10-K and 8-K in the sample has its main document extracted or is listed with the reason it failed; findings record counts, bytes, elapsed time and failure rate
      Leaves out: durable state and replay (Stage 5); full-history submissions (Stage 6); scheduling and deployment (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 5: Durable state and replay
      Objective: Make index, submission and extraction runs resumable and replayable from retained source bytes.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3
      Consumes: Stages 1–4 code; Stage 3 and 4 findings
      Produces: Per-file checkpoints, retained raw source bytes, manifests and versioned publication that later stages may assume
      Exit: An interrupted run resumes without refetching completed files; a parser change rebuilds output from retained bytes with no SEC requests and no duplicate records
      Leaves out: quarterly reconciliation (Stage 7); scheduling and deployment (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 6: Full-history submissions and 10-K/8-K handling
      Objective: Run submission download and 10-K/8-K extraction over the full history, scoped by Stage 3's measured cost.
      Outcomes: O2, O3
      Consumes: Stage 5's checkpoints and manifests; Stage 3 findings (projection); Stage 4's extraction code
      Produces: Full-history submissions and extracted 10-K/8-K main documents; specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-6-findings.md
      Exit: Every submission in the agreed scope is downloaded or listed as an unresolved gap, and every 10-K/8-K in it is extracted or listed with its failure; findings record the measured cost of the full run
      Leaves out: quarterly reconciliation (Stage 7); scheduling and deployment (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 7: Quarterly reconciliation
      Objective: Re-read quarterly indexes and account for SEC corrections without discarding history.
      Outcomes: O1
      Consumes: Stage 5's retained bytes, manifests and versioned publication
      Produces: Recorded additions, field changes and gated withdrawals for each reconciled quarter
      Exit: A reconciliation run over real quarters reports its changes; a fixture that removes keys from a closed quarter leaves the prior version active until approved
      Leaves out: scheduling and deployment (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 8: Scheduling and deployment
      Objective: Choose the hosting platform and run daily ingestion and reconciliation on schedule under one shared SEC request budget.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3
      Consumes: Stages 2, 5, 6 and 7
      Produces: Deployed scheduled runs, shared request budget across collectors, monitoring, alerts and runbooks
      Exit: Observed scheduled daily and reconciliation runs complete with durable reports; concurrent collectors stay within one request budget
      Leaves out: nothing
      ROUTING: brainstorming

## Stage-spec stamp

Every stage spec's Rollout note carries this line, which writing-plans copies verbatim into the stage plan's header:

> Roadmap: specs/sec-filing-ingestion-roadmap.md, Stage N — on plan completion, tick the stage and re-validate later stages against what shipped.

## Completion

When every stage is ticked, run derive-roadmap §6 over the Outcomes list (O1–O3): one verdict per outcome with evidence (implementing stage and plan, Deviation notes, deferred_items entries). An unmet outcome exits as a new stage or a written deferral.
